description: Platform administration — infrastructure, deployment, secrets, monitoring, access control.
rules: Secrets management: .env in project root (gitignored); no .env/.key/.pem inside Northstar_backend/.
Cloudflare Workers deployment via wrangler.toml; KV bindings for scored data/CSVs.
Windows Task Scheduler for Costco catalog refresh (interactive logon, Limited run level, StartWhenAvailable).
Protected artifacts never overwritten: scanner-search-cache, costco-items.csv, benchmark CSVs, enriched caches.
Audit log: append-only JSONL with timestamp, track, files touched, live action requested, approval status.
